title: Dedicated Lanes at Immigration for Singaporeans and Permanent Residents after Introduction of Automated Lanes for Foreigners
what_it_is: Dedicated Lanes at Immigration for Singaporeans and Permanent Residents after Introduction of Automated Lanes for Foreigners

sections.label: Dedicated lane proportion adjustment
sections.summary: The proportion of dedicated lanes will be flexibly adjusted to meet prevailing operational needs, taking into account the traveller profile.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The proportion of dedicated lanes will be flexibly adjusted to meet prevailing operational needs, taking into account the traveller profile.

sections.label: Special assistance lanes at Terminal 2
sections.summary: Special assistance lanes for families with young children and those with additional needs are being built, with Terminal 2 completed.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In fact, I visited Terminal 2 recently, during the festive period, to thank our officers for working during the festive period; and among the facilities that I saw was the special assistance lane.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: These are for families, especially those with young children, and also for those with additional needs.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We had the lane very, very, very wide and it enables even those with very young children to go through.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: They can pass through as a group, as a family.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, if you look at what we have shared recently during the statistics release, we are building some of these lanes.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For some, we have completed; for example, Terminal 2 that I visited, it is completed.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: And we are among the first, if not, the first in the world, to have these facilities.
